# useIndustryForm

<a id="useindustryform"></a>

> **useIndustryForm**(`props`: [`UseIndustryFormProps`](#useindustryformprops)): [`HookLoadingResult`](../../hooks.md#hookloadingresult) \| [`UseIndustryFormReady`](#useindustryformready)

Form hook for selecting and saving a company's industry classification.

## Remarks

Loads the company's current classification and the full NAICS code list, then issues a
PUT on submit. Valid NAICS codes are four to six digits, but the bundled list holds only
six-digit classifications — when the company's saved code is shorter (or otherwise absent
from the list) the hook adds an option for it, labelled with the title the API returned,
so the saved classification displays and survives a submit that does not change it.

## Example

```tsx title="Example"
import {
  useIndustryForm,
  SDKFormProvider,
  type UseIndustryFormReady,
} from '@gusto/embedded-react-sdk'

function IndustryPage({ companyId }: { companyId: string }) {
  const industry = useIndustryForm({ companyId })

  if (industry.isLoading) return <div>Loading...</div>

  return <IndustryReady industry={industry} />
}

function IndustryReady({ industry }: { industry: UseIndustryFormReady }) {
  const { Fields } = industry.form

  return (
    <SDKFormProvider formHookResult={industry}>
      <form onSubmit={e => { e.preventDefault(); void industry.actions.onSubmit() }}>
        <Fields.Industry label="Industry" placeholder="Select an industry" />
        <button type="submit" disabled={industry.status.isPending}>Save</button>
      </form>
    </SDKFormProvider>
  )
}
```

the industry-specific `data`, `status`, `actions`, and `form.Fields` shape.

| Property | Type | Description |
| ------ | ------ | ------ |

| `data` | `object` | Static entity data resolved from the API. |
| `data.industry` | [`Industry`](../../APIModels/index.md#industry) \| `null` | The classification currently on file; `null` when the company has none. |
| `data.naicsCodes` | [`NaicsCode`](../types.md#naicscode)[] | Every selectable NAICS classification, including the saved one when it is not part of the bundled list. |
| `errorHandling` | [`HookErrorHandling`](../../hooks.md#hookerrorhandling) | Error state and recovery actions. |
| `form` | `object` | Form bindings: pre-bound field components, per-field metadata, submission values, and react-hook-form internals. |
| `form.Fields` | [`IndustryFormFields`](#industryformfields) | - |
| `form.fieldsMetadata` | [`IndustryFieldsMetadata`](#industryfieldsmetadata) | - |
| `form.getFormSubmissionValues` | () => [`IndustryFormData`](#industryformdata) \| `undefined` | - |
| `form.hookFormInternals` | [`HookFormInternals`](../../hooks.md#hookforminternals)\<[`IndustryFormData`](#industryformdata)\> | - |
| `isLoading` | `false` | Always `false` in this branch; discriminates from [HookLoadingResult](../../hooks.md#hookloadingresult). |

## Fields

### IndustryFormFields

<a id="industryformfields"></a>

Pre-bound field components exposed on `useIndustryForm().form.Fields`.

| Property | Type | Description |
| ------ | ------ | ------ |
| `Industry` | `ComponentType`\<[`IndustryFieldProps`](#industryfieldprops)\> | Bound to `naicsCode`. Filterable industry selector over the full NAICS code list, emitting `REQUIRED` when left empty. When the company's saved classification is not one of the listed codes, an extra option for it is added so the saved value stays visible and selected; its entry carries an empty `title` when the API supplied none, which `getOptionLabel` can use to substitute its own copy. |

### Industry

Bound to `naicsCode`. Filterable industry selector over the full NAICS code list,
emitting `REQUIRED` when left empty. When the company's saved classification is not
one of the listed codes, an extra option for it is added so the saved value stays
visible and selected; its entry carries an empty `title` when the API supplied none,
which `getOptionLabel` can use to substitute its own copy.

```tsx
<form.Fields.Industry
  label="Industry"
  validationMessages={{ REQUIRED: '…' }}
/>
```

<a id="industryfieldprops"></a>

#### IndustryFieldProps

> [`HookFieldProps`](../../hooks.md#hookfieldprops)\<[`ComboBoxHookFieldProps`](../../hooks.md#comboboxhookfieldprops)\<[`IndustryRequiredValidation`](#industryrequiredvalidation), [`NaicsCode`](../types.md#naicscode)\>\>

Props accepted by [useIndustryForm](#useindustryform)'s `Fields.Industry` component.

| Property | Type | Description |
| ------ | ------ | ------ |
| `label` | `string` | Visible label rendered above the field. |
| `placeholder` | `string` | Placeholder text displayed when no option is selected. Required so empty dropdowns always communicate the action — pass an empty string only when a default value is guaranteed. |
| `getOptionLabel?` | (`entry`: [`NaicsCode`](../types.md#naicscode)) => `string` | Maps a raw option entry to its display label; when omitted, options use the labels provided by the hook. |
| `validationMessages?` | [`ValidationMessages`](../../hooks.md#validationmessages)\<[`IndustryRequiredValidation`](#industryrequiredvalidation)\> | Custom error text keyed by validation error code. |

_Also accepts `description`, `formHookResult`, `portalContainer` from [ComboBoxHookFieldProps](../../hooks.md#comboboxhookfieldprops)._
